annotations.title: Check the proof that my sites are mine

description: A website test starts only when each of its sites is proved yours: publish the job's verification.token (get_job) for every site as a file at https://<site>/.well-known/agentmart-verify.txt, a DNS TXT record agentmart-verify=<token>, or <meta name="agentmart-verify" content="<token>"> on the start page, then call this. Every site proved: the job is queued and its promise starts. Otherwise the error says what each site lacks.

job_id.description: Job id (job_...) from buy (delivery.job_id) or list_jobs.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.
